manual_version: TU21 (final, 2024-04-09; Section 5 ARENA V8, Section 6 Game Details V10, Section 8 ROBOT Construction Rules V8)

melody_rp.description: At least the threshold number of AMP and SPEAKER NOTES scored (AUTO and TELEOP); the Coopertition Bonus lowers the threshold by 3 (Table 6-2)

ensemble_rp.description: At least 10 STAGE points and at least 2 ONSTAGE ROBOTS (Table 6-2; the same at every event tier)

coopertition_bonus.description: Both ALLIANCES use a NOTE scored in their AMP to press the Coopertition button within the first 45 seconds of TELEOP (match time above 1:30): all teams earn 1 Coopertition Point (a ranking tiebreaker, not a ranking point) and the MELODY threshold drops by 3 NOTES. Unused in Playoff MATCHES (section 6.5.5)

robot_constraints.note: Weight excludes BUMPERS, the battery, and event-provided location tags (R103; 125 lbs until Team Update 21 raised it to 125.5 lbs for the VH-109 radio). Perimeter and height per R104.

analysis_hints.endgame_activity: Climbing attempts (onstage) and trap scoring typically occur in the final 20 seconds.
analysis_hints.scoring_context: Notes can be scored in Speaker (2 pts unamplified, 5 pts amplified) or Amp (1 pt). Amplification lasts 10 seconds, or until 4 Notes are scored in the Speaker, after 2 Notes are scored in the Amp.
analysis_hints.cycle_time: Note cycle = intake from field/source -> score in Speaker or Amp. Track time between successive scores.
analysis_hints.auto_importance: Auto Notes score 5 pts each in Speaker. Leaving the starting zone scores 2 pts.
analysis_hints.stage_context: ENSEMBLE RP needs at least 10 STAGE points and at least 2 ONSTAGE robots; HARMONY (2 pts) is awarded per additional robot on the same chain.
